questions.stem: A 70-year-old patient who is a known case of diabetes and hypertension is posted for an elective laparoscopic hernioplasty and takes regular insulin and oral glimepiride for his diabetes and tablet telmisartan and amlodipine for his hypertension. What would be the pre-operative advice you will give to this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Omit the morning dose of both insulin and glimepiride and continue antihypertensives

options.label: B
options.text: Omit all medications on the day of surgery

options.label: C
options.text: Continue all medications on the day of surgery

options.label: D
options.text: Omit insulin, glimepiride and telmisartan and continue amlodipine on the day of surgery
